Class CameraService

java.lang.Object
aslframework.ui.CameraService
public class CameraService extends Object
Captures live frames from the default webcam using OpenCV and converts them to JavaFX Image objects for display in GameUI.

When landmark display is enabled via setShowLandmarks(boolean), the 21 hand landmarks are drawn directly onto the Mat frame using OpenCV before it is converted to a JavaFX Image. This means the dots are always correctly positioned regardless of how the ImageView is scaled or stretched in the UI.

    • loadNativeLibrary

      public static void loadNativeLibrary(String nativeLibPath)
      Loads the OpenCV native library from the given absolute path. Must be called once before any OpenCV class is used.
      Parameters:
      nativeLibPath - absolute path to libopencv_java4130.dylib

    • start

      public void start(Consumer<javafx.scene.image.Image> onFrame)
      Starts the capture loop. The given callback is invoked on a background thread with each new frame as a JavaFX Image.
      Parameters:
      onFrame - callback that receives each frame

      public void stop()
